blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A civic group in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) has urged President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to discuss the exit agreement with the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), a key step toward completing the peace process. In a statement Tuesday, AMANA BARMM welcomed Palace press officer Claire Castro’s announcement that Malacañang was arranging a meeting between Marcos and MILF chairperson Al Haj Murad Ebrahim to discuss the implementation of the Bangsamoro peace agreement. However, no definite date has been set for the meeting. READ: MILF chief seeks meeting with Marcos In a letter dated Oct. 1 […]...
